reply.emotion: curious and attentive, taking in the air around
notes: Sentir can mean both to perceive an odor (smell) and to experience an emotion or physical sensation (feel), much like to feel in English.

senses.definition: To perceive or notice an odor or scent using your nose.

examples.text: Je sens une bonne odeur de pain.
examples.translation: I smell the good scent of bread.
examples.emotion: hungry and pleased, enjoying the warm aroma

senses.definition: To experience a physical sensation or an emotion inside yourself.

examples.text: Je me sens très fatigué aujourd'hui.
examples.emotion: tired and slow, speaking with a heavy voice

definitions: To perceive or notice an odor or scent using your nose.
To experience a physical sensation or an emotion inside yourself.
